items.title: Open Source Flutter Apps
items.content_text:
### Productivity

*   [ParrotFlow](https://openappscout.com/apps/parrotflow/) - Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links. ([Source (⭐22)](https://github.com/znat/parrotflow))

### Tools

*   [LayoutKeeper](https://openappscout.com/apps/layoutkeeper/) - macOS menu bar app that saves window layouts per external monitor and restores positions, sizes, and Spaces on reconnect. ([Source (⭐34)](https://github.com/tumingke0/LayoutKeeper))

### Developer Tools

*   [RunWisp](https://openappscout.com/apps/runwisp/) - crond and supervisord in one binary, with a web dashboard and a TUI. ([Source (⭐85)](https://github.com/runwisp/runwisp))

### Communication

*   [Pomelu](https://openappscout.com/apps/pomelu/) - Open-source Android and iOS app to chat with your self-hosted Hermes Agent bots. ([Source (⭐9)](https://github.com/ateymoori/pomelu))

### Business

*   [Relaticle](https://openappscout.com/apps/relaticle/) - Open-source CRM with a built-in AI assistant and an MCP server, self-hosted with Docker or on Relaticle Cloud. ([Source (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle))

items.title: Awesome Dataviz
items.content_text:
### JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

*   [Britecharts (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/britecharts/britecharts) - Accessible D3-based charts for JavaScript and React, with keyboard navigation, dark mode and TypeScript support.

### JavaScript tools / Financial charts

*   [Lightweight Charts React Components (⭐140)](https://github.com/ukorvl/lightweight-charts-react-components) - Declarative React components for financial charts built on TradingView Lightweight Charts.

### JavaScript tools / Misc

*   [AVA (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/antvis/AVA) - TypeScript visual analytics framework for AI agents, with file and database queries, reusable business definitions and interactive charts.

### Other tools / Text visualization

*   [evident-charts (⭐62)](https://github.com/rhiever/evident-charts) - Agent skill that makes explanatory charts and checks them for misleading axes, overlapping labels, and color problems.
*   [RustGIS (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/opengeos/RustGIS) - Fast, free and open-source GIS for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data, native and in the browser.

items.title: Awesome Transit
items.content_text:
### Proprietary (non-standard) vendor APIs / Rust

*   [InfraNode](https://infranode.dev) - Keyless REST (and MCP) API for 84+ German cities. Includes public-transport stops and live departures with real-time delays (DELFI/GTFS, HVV, VGN), alongside weather, air quality, traffic and roadworks. No API key.

items.title: Awesome Open Source Games
items.content_text:
### Browser-Based / Boardgame

*   [Daily Word Hunt (⭐1)](https://github.com/s87343472/daily-word-hunt) - Free browser daily word search (find-the-word). New puzzle every day, themed series, print packs.
*   [Chessmata (⭐20)](https://github.com/metavert-io/chessmata) - Open-source multiplayer chess platform for humans and AI agents, with real-time WebSocket gameplay, Elo-based matchmaking, 3D browser board (Three.js), MCP server, and UCI-compatible CLI. Built with Go and React.

### Browser-Based / Arcade

*   [Trick or Take (⭐0)](https://github.com/zicojiao/trick-or-take) - Multiplayer Halloween party web game built with vanilla Canvas 2D, Agora RTC voice chat, and Cloudflare Workers edge.
*   [Wave Rider Nusantara (⭐6)](https://github.com/abusofianid/game-wave-rider-nusantara) - Arcade game inspired by Indonesian culture, featuring the legendary character Gatot Kaca and traditional Batik patterns. Built with React and JavaScript.

### Browser-Based / Sandbox

*   [Cubyz (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/PixelGuys/Cubyz) - Open voxel simulation game in active development with building, crafting and survival mechanics. Licensed under GPL3.

### Browser-Based / Geography

*   [World Chase (⭐0)](https://github.com/JezKirkpatrick/WorldChase) - Competitive weekly geography game. Decode cryptic riddles to find real-world locations on a map. Global leaderboard, VS duels, 25 new challenges every week.
*   [Kids World Chase (⭐0)](https://github.com/JezKirkpatrick/kids-world-chase) - Weekly geography adventure for children aged 8-13. Solve riddles, explore real locations via Google Street View.
